description: Compatibility alias of listing_guard for existing clients. Prefer listing_guard for a new detailed metadata check; these are the same operation, not two independent checks. Bazaar Listing Guard: CDP technical validation plus a bounded heuristic metadata screen for agent-directed instructions, embedded URLs, tool calls, invisible Unicode, long fields and prices above 100x a fresh Scout category median. Returns riskScore, flagged spans and rewrite suggestions. Not Coinbase policy certification or guaranteed detection. Public HTTPS only; no target payment or request bodies stored. Price $0.05 USDC on Base; shared trial may apply. Price: 0.05 USDC. Minimal input example: {"url":"https://api.spendpreflight.com/v1/check","method":"GET"}. Illustrative output excerpt: {"cdpPreflight":{"valid":true,"preflight":[],"index":null},"riskScore":0,"flags":[],"suggestedRewrite":[],"screenComplete":true,"priceCompared":false,"indexActive":null,"example_note":"Illustrative response only; not a live result or safety guarantee."}. Illustrative output excerpt, not a live result, signature, approval or guarantee. Freshness/data/availability checks still apply. How to pay (MCP): First use the existing shared allowance of 3 eligible calls per IP per UTC day, without payment metadata. This is shared with eligible HTTP trials, not a new allowance. Use an x402-capable MCP client. A generic MCP connector without payment support cannot complete a paid continuation. On payment required, STOP. Inspect the exact accepts amount, asset, network and payTo; obtain explicit wallet/budget approval before continuing. Only after approval, let the configured x402 MCP client attach its signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] and retry the same tools/call arguments. Never send a separate USDC transfer or paste keys into tool arguments. Never silently fall back from free access to payment. If a signed attempt has an unknown outcome, inspect that authorization/transaction; do not create another automatically.
